accepted_claims: Zero relative ends iff finite index.
For g>=2, infinite-index H with vcd(H)<=4g-7 has one relative end.
At least two relative ends forces vcd(H) in {4g-6,4g-5}.
Genus2 realizes 0,1,2,continuum with finitely generated H.
Generator bounds10 and8 for genus2 two-ended and continuum-ended witnesses.
